basic_info.description: Updated move-in ready condo in a convenient SoMa location for an exceptional price. This studio condo is in a modern building built in 1991. The unit offers a smart layout that maximizes space and flexibility. It features a nice kitchen, recently updated bathroom, a space-saving built-in Murphy bed as well as good closet and storage space. The kitchen is equipped with an electric range, refrigerator, dishwasher, and nice cabinet space. The bathroom has good counter and cabinet space. Nice lighting throughout. The unit is away from the street. There is a laundry room on the unit's floor. Deeded storage locker on the first floor that can fit bikes and gear. The building's roof deck has great views. Low HOA dues. Enjoy being close to popular restaurants, cafes, shops, museums, and nightlife. Conveniently located near BART, MUNI, shuttles, and freeway access. This could be a cozy first home or pied-a-terre. Don't miss the opportunity to buy this turnkey condo at a great price. This is not a BMR unit.
